//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 202): THE PORTABLE STENCHMASTER ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM, GRAND TRAVEL MODEL. A tiny CRT in a crooked purple cabinet, mismatched knobs, a fork for an aerial, two tubes showing, Cheap-O-Rama stickers and some very ridiculous safety labels. Garrick took it out of his coat. Distinct from the Mark II (ses_mk2), which is still in the galley: this one lives in the Fart-Free Zone. It only ever gets the Stenchmaster Channel. Nothing about it is a real procedure.
